'''Binspo''' was a game often played in [[Casino/Legends|casinos]]. The [[Casino Kuari]] on board the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] had Binspo among its games. In [[44 ABY]] ''[[Galactic Princess]]'' also had Binspo on board among other popular games.
